content.text:
Here is the complete picture of the Markdown processing interface pattern in this repository.

---

## 1. The Interface

**File:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (lines 31-55)

The interface is `markdown.Service`, defined in Go:

```go
type Service interface {
    ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
    ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
    ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
    RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)
    RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)
    GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
    ValidateContent(content []byte) error
    RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
}
```

It provides methods for parsing markdown to extract metadata (tags, mentions, properties), rendering markdown back to markdown text or to HTML, generating plain-text snippets, validating content, and renaming tags.

---

## 2. Concrete Implementation

There is exactly **one** concrete implementation -- the unexported struct `service` in the same file (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 57-60):

```go
type service struct {
    md goldmark.Markdown
}
```

This wraps the [goldmark](https://github.com/yuin/goldmark) Markdown library. It is configured with GFM (GitHub Flavored Markdown) and optionally with custom tag (`#tag`) and mention (`@username`) parser extensions defined in:

- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/tag.go` (custom AST node `TagNode`)
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/mention.go` (custom AST node `MentionNode`)

The `service` also delegates AST-to-markdown rendering to `MarkdownRenderer` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`. This is a plain struct (not behind an interface), used internally by `RenderMarkdown()` and `RenameTag()`.

There are **no mock or alternative implementations** of `markdown.Service` -- tests use the real service with `markdown.NewService(...)`.

---

## 3. Construction / Instantiation

The `Service` is created via the factory function `markdown.NewService(opts ...Option)` (line 85 of the same file). It is constructed in **two** locations:

**a) Production code** -- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (lines 47-51)

Inside `NewAPIV1Service()`:
```go
markdownService := markdown.NewService(
    markdown.WithTagExtension(),
    markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
)
```
This is called from `/bench/repo/server/server.go` line 76:
```go
apiV1Service := apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(s.Secret, profile, store)
```

**b) Test code** -- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go` (lines 44-47)

Identical construction inside `NewTestService()`:
```go
markdownService := markdown.NewService(
    markdown.WithTagExtension(),
    markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
)
```

---

## 4. Components Holding References to the Interface

Three structs hold a `markdown.Service` field:

| Struct | File | Field Name | How It Gets the Service |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APIV1Service` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` | `MarkdownService` | Creates it in its own constructor `NewAPIV1Service()` |
| `RSSService` | `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45` | `MarkdownService` | Receives it via constructor parameter; the caller (`server.go:85`) passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` |
| `Runner` (memopayload) | `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` | `MarkdownService` | Receives it via constructor parameter `NewRunner()` |

Additionally, the standalone function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload()` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` accepts `markdown.Service` as a parameter. It is called from:
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo()` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`
- `APIV1Service` memo update logic at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`
- `Runner.RunOnce()` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52`

**Usage points on `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` directly:**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` -- `ExtractAll()` for resolving @mentions
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85` -- `GenerateSnippet()` for webhook payloads

**Usage on `RSSService.MarkdownService`:**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:339` -- `RenderHTML()` for RSS feed item descriptions

---

## Dependency Flow Summary

```
server.NewServer()
  |
  +--> apiv1.NewAPIV1Service()       // creates markdown.NewService(...) internally
  |      |
  |      +--> APIV1Service.MarkdownService  (field)
  |             |
  |             +--> used by memo_service.go, memo_mention_helpers.go, memo_service_webhooks.go
  |             |
  |             +--> passed to memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload() (function parameter)
  |
  +--> rss.NewRSSService(..., apiV1Service.MarkdownService)
         |
         +--> RSSService.MarkdownService  (field)
                +--> used by rss.go for RenderHTML()
```

The `memopayload.Runner` struct can also hold the service but is **not currently instantiated** in `server.go`'s `startBackgroundRunners()` -- only the S3 presign runner is started there. The `Runner` and `RebuildMemoPayload` function are used ad-hoc via direct calls from the API service.

---

## Frontend (TypeScript) -- Separate Approach, No Shared Interface

The frontend at `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx` uses a completely separate markdown stack: `react-markdown` with `remark-gfm`, `remark-breaks`, `remark-math`, `rehype-katex`, `rehype-raw`, `rehype-sanitize`, plus custom remark/rehype plugins for tags, mentions, and task lists. There is no TypeScript interface abstracting markdown processing -- the rendering is done declaratively via React component composition with `<ReactMarkdown>`. The `MarkdownRenderContext` at `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MarkdownRenderContext.tsx` is a React context for tracking nesting depth, not a processing interface.
